title: Blank tape preserved outside an empty set
statement: Let $d$ and $d'$ be configurations with the same number of work tapes and input, possibly with different state types, and let $F_j$ be a set of integer positions for each tape $j$. Suppose the tapes of $d$ and $d'$ agree at every position outside the corresponding set $F_j$. If $F_j$ is empty for a tape $j$ and that tape of $d$ is blank at every position, then that tape of $d'$ is blank at every position as well.

The chosen tape of $d$ is blank at every integer position
